entries.heading: A clear place to start
entries.text: Tell us your destination, dates, number of travellers and budget. We use your enquiry to understand what you need before discussing a suitable service.

entries.heading: Plans shaped around you
entries.text: Choose a personalised trip enquiry when you need help building a journey, or a package enquiry when a published destination package interests you.

entries.heading: Get in touch
entries.text: We operate online. Contact Travel With Ease to discuss your travel plans.

about.heading: Travel planning, with you in mind

services.body: From an initial travel-readiness conversation to a personalised plan or destination package, start with the service that fits your needs.
services.seoTitle: Find the right support for your trip | Travel With Ease
services.seoDescription: From an initial travel-readiness conversation to a personalised plan or destination package, start with the service that fits your needs.

entries.heading: Travel Readiness Session
entries.text: A focused advisory conversation for travellers who want help understanding destination options, budgets and travel preparation. It is separate from full itinerary planning and visa services. Scope, fees and scheduling are confirmed before payment.

entries.heading: Personalised trip planning
entries.text: Share your dates, destination ideas, travel party and budget. We discuss the planning scope and service terms before starting work. Travel costs and third-party services are quoted separately.

entries.heading: Destination packages and group trips
entries.text: Enquire about an approved package, tier, travel dates and number of travellers. Published “from” prices are indicative per person sharing, subject to the stated package terms and availability. An enquiry does not reserve a place.

entries.heading: Payments and bookings
entries.text: There is no online checkout on this website. Agreed services are invoiced separately. Follow only payment instructions confirmed directly by Travel With Ease.

how-it-works.body: Start with an enquiry. We review your plans, agree the scope with you, and confirm the next steps before any booking or payment commitment.
how-it-works.seoTitle: From your first idea to a clear plan | Travel With Ease
how-it-works.seoDescription: Start with an enquiry. We review your plans, agree the scope with you, and confirm the next steps before any booking or payment commitment.

entries.heading: 1. Tell us what you have in mind
entries.text: For a personalised trip, share destination ideas, dates, budget and traveller count. For a destination package, select the package and tier you are interested in.

entries.heading: 2. Review the options together
entries.text: We assess your enquiry and discuss the service that fits. You can ask questions about the scope, costs, availability and preparation required.

entries.heading: 3. Agree the details
entries.text: Review your written scope, quote, invoice and applicable supplier terms. No enquiry acknowledgement is a booking confirmation.

entries.heading: 4. Confirm arrangements
entries.text: Bookings and service work proceed only under the agreed terms, approvals and payment instructions. Keep the written confirmations for your records.

privacy.body: Travel With Ease uses personal information to respond to enquiries, provide agreed travel services and operate this website. This draft requires Owner review before publication.
privacy.seoDescription: How Travel With Ease uses personal information to respond to enquiries, provide agreed travel services and operate this website.

entries.heading: Who is responsible
entries.text: Travel With Ease. Proposed privacy contact: nana@travelwitheasegh.com; telephone +233 20 020 9170. Confirm this contact designation before publication.

entries.heading: Information you provide
entries.text: Enquiries can include your name, email, telephone or WhatsApp number, destination, dates, traveller count, budget, service or package choice and optional notes. The website does not request card details, passport scans or identity documents at launch. Avoid entering unnecessary sensitive information in free-text fields.

entries.heading: Information generated when you use the service
entries.text: We retain enquiry references, submission and notice timestamps, source information, delivery status and staff actions needed to manage the request. Hosting and security services can process IP addresses, request metadata and security events. Cookie preferences are stored in your browser.

entries.heading: Why information is used
entries.text: We use enquiries to assess your request and communicate with you; agreed service information to prepare and perform the service; operational records to protect the service and meet applicable obligations. Where we rely on consent, you may withdraw it. Marketing requires separate opt-in and is not a condition of making an enquiry.

entries.heading: Analytics and search visibility
entries.text: Optional Google Analytics measures public website visits and approved interactions only after analytics consent, subject to browser privacy preferences. Enquiry answers, email addresses and private portal activity must not enter analytics. Google Search Console reports how the public website appears in Google Search; it is separate from the website's analytics tag and is not enabled by an analytics-cookie toggle.

entries.heading: Service providers and communications
entries.text: Cloudflare, Railway, Resend and Google may process information for hosting/security, operational storage, email, optional analytics or search reporting, according to the services actually enabled. Production acknowledgement emails are sent to the customer with notifications@travelwitheasegh.com in CC. WhatsApp, Instagram and TikTok links take you to those providers, whose own terms apply. Confirm provider contracts, hosting locations and any cross-border safeguards before publication.

entries.heading: Retention and security
entries.text: We limit access by staff role and protect records with the application's security controls. Personal information should be retained only as long as required for its purpose and applicable obligations. Confirm and implement the retention/deletion schedule, backup handling and any required financial/audit retention before publication.

entries.heading: Your choices and rights
entries.text: Contact the privacy contact to request access or correction, raise an objection, withdraw consent where applicable, or ask about deletion. We may verify your identity proportionately. You may also raise a complaint with Ghana's Data Protection Commission at https://dpc.gov.gh. Requests are handled under applicable Ghanaian law, including the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843).

entries.heading: Before this notice is published
entries.text: Confirm the designated privacy contact, DPC registration status, actual processors and locations, retention periods and rights-request procedure. Set the approval and effective date after review.

privacy.heading: Privacy notice

cookies.body: Essential browser storage supports security and remembers your privacy choice. Optional analytics is disabled until you choose to allow it.
cookies.seoTitle: Cookies and browser preferences | Travel With Ease
cookies.seoDescription: Essential browser storage supports security and remembers your privacy choice. Optional analytics is disabled until you choose to allow it.

entries.heading: Essential storage
entries.text: The public site stores your cookie preference under twe-cookie-consent-v1. Staff authentication uses separate protected session storage/cookies. Essential security processing may also be provided by the hosting and access providers; confirm their enabled settings in the final storage inventory.

entries.heading: Optional analytics
entries.text: If enabled and approved, Google Analytics measures public website usage. Its tag is blocked before analytics consent. Analytics may store Google Analytics identifiers such as _ga and measurement-specific cookies. Confirm actual cookie names and lifetimes from the deployed configuration before publication.

entries.heading: Manage your preferences
entries.text: Choose Essential only to reject optional analytics, Allow analytics to accept it, or Manage preferences to make a selection. Use Cookie settings in the footer to change or withdraw the choice later. Browser privacy controls and Do Not Track are respected by the existing analytics integration.

entries.heading: External links and search reporting
entries.text: Opening WhatsApp, Instagram or TikTok takes you to another service; we do not embed their tracking widgets. Search Console ownership verification and search-performance reports are separate from optional website analytics cookies.

entries.heading: Review requirements
entries.text: Confirm the live storage inventory, expiration periods and effective date before publishing this policy.

terms.body: This website is operated by Travel With Ease. These draft terms require Owner and appropriate legal review before publication.
terms.seoTitle: Website and enquiry terms | Travel With Ease
terms.seoDescription: Terms for using the Travel With Ease website and submitting a travel enquiry.

entries.heading: Using the website
entries.text: Use the website and enquiry forms lawfully and provide accurate information you are entitled to share. Enquiries allow us to discuss travel services with you; submission alone does not create a confirmed booking.

entries.heading: Services and quotations
entries.text: Personalised travel planning, readiness advice, destination packages and group trips have separate scopes and terms. Review the written scope, quotation, availability and supplier conditions before agreeing to a service. Visa decisions and travel-entry requirements remain subject to the relevant authorities.

entries.heading: Indicative package prices
entries.text: A published “from” price is indicative per person sharing unless the package expressly states otherwise. Final costs depend on dates, party size, availability, inclusions and supplier terms. No hotel names or unapproved prices should be inferred from placeholder content.

entries.heading: Payments, changes and cancellation
entries.text: There is no online checkout at launch. Payment instructions, invoices, deposits, balances, cancellation and refund terms are provided for the agreed service. Confirm the approved contractual policy before publication; do not infer refund rights or fees from this draft.

entries.heading: Third-party services
entries.text: Travel services may involve airlines, accommodation and other suppliers with their own conditions. The final agreement must identify the scope of TWE's responsibility and applicable supplier conditions. Do not publish an unrestricted liability exclusion.

entries.heading: Contact and privacy
entries.text: Contact nana@travelwitheasegh.com or WhatsApp +233 20 838 7020 with questions. Review the approved Privacy and Cookie policies for information handling and browser preferences.

entries.heading: Before publication
entries.text: Confirm service-specific payment/refund provisions, complaints procedure, applicable law and dispute provisions, and the approval/effective date.
